Class IngredientReportController

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.controller.IngredientReportController
public class IngredientReportController extends Object
Controller for the manager's ingredient usage report (ingredient-report-view.fxml). Shows how many servings of each ingredient were used by the orders placed in a date range, either as a table or as a bar chart.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded. Fills the Table/Graph choice and shows only the chosen view, sets up the chart series and the table columns (Ingredient, Quantity Used), defaults the date range to the last 7 days, and connects the Run button.

    • runReport

      private void runReport()
      Runs the report for the selected start and end dates (both inclusive) in the background, then fills both the table and the chart with one row per ingredient. The table and chart are disabled while the report runs. The status label reports progress, "no usage" when the range has no orders, or the error if the query fails.
